name: barrier_so101
trained_on: MolmoAct2-SO100_101 (lerobot/MolmoAct2-SO100_101-LeRobot, bf16 re-save, ONE-VIEW copy MolmoAct2-SO100_101-LeRobot-1cam: wrist camera cam0 only), real SO-101 frames, two pens (red/green); calibrated OFFLINE only (velocity matching to the same frozen policy prompted "pick up the red pen" on recorded frames; students "pick up the pen" and "pick up the green pen"), initialised from the LIBERO round-3 module. No real-robot runs yet. Not checked on the two-camera checkpoint or with markers.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)

bank.how: SO-101 bank: mean block-6 output of the 5 tokens ' pick up the red pen' under the teacher prompt over recorded SO-101 frames (steervla runs/steering_so101/data/bank_red.npy); frozen

cameras: one view (wrist, cam0); the policy_checkpoint check cannot tell 1cam from 2cam, use the -1cam checkpoint
k_note: k scales the edit, u = k * ReLU(tau - <a,h>) a; k = 1 is the calibrated module and the chosen k (pre-registered offline rule); at k = 1 the edit-scale and threshold-scale forms coincide
calibration: steervla runs/steering_so101/results.md (offline proxy, held-out real frames): barrier k=1 reaches 12% of the no-edit loss; matches the red teacher heading on 20/20 two-pen frames under the neutral and the green prompt; beats the calibrated constant (loss ratio 0.65); zero-edit fraction 0 (never switches off)
